args.code:
import re, pathlib

root = pathlib.Path('servisler')
files = [p for p in root.rglob('*.ini') if 'yedek' not in p.parts]

for f in files:
    data = f.read_bytes()
    bom = b''
    body = data
    if data.startswith(b'\xef\xbb\xbf'):
        bom, body = b'\xef\xbb\xbf', data[3:]
    lines = body.splitlines(keepends=True)

    in_section = False
    changed = 0
    out = []
    for line in lines:
        stripped = line.strip()
        if re.match(r'^\[[^\]]*\]\s*$', stripped, flags=re.IGNORECASE):
            name = stripped[1:-1].strip().lower() if stripped.startswith('[') and stripped.rstrip().endswith(']') else ''
            in_section = name == 'veritabani'
        elif not line.lstrip().startswith(';'):
            new_line, n = re.subn(r'^(\s*port\s*=\s*)5432(\r?\n?)$', r'\g<1>6543\g<2>', line)
            if in_section and n:
                changed += 1
                out.append(new_line.encode('utf-8'))
                continue
        out.append(line.encode('utf-8'))

    f.write_bytes(bom + b''.join(out))
    print(f.name, 'changed:', changed)
